newsHighlights.title: Coercion not the right approach to settling differences
newsHighlights.summary: The European Union's trade policy toward China keeps raising the stakes and setting deadlines, but coercion is not the right approach to settling differences.
newsHighlights.translation: 欧盟对华贸易政策不断抬高赌注、设定最后期限，但胁迫并不是解决分歧的正确方式。

newsHighlights.title: Targeting a continental shift
newsHighlights.summary: A 19-year-old race walker marked a milestone more than five decades in the making by winning the men's half-marathon race walk in Nagoya.
newsHighlights.translation: 一位19岁的竞走运动员在名古屋赢得男子半程马拉松竞走冠军，实现了一个酝酿五十余年的里程碑。

newsHighlights.title: What keeps China's high-speed trains so steady?
newsHighlights.summary: Behind the legendary steadiness of China's high-speed trains lies a system of precise engineering and constant communication among maintenance crews.
newsHighlights.translation: 中国高铁之所以如此平稳，背后是精密的工程体系与检修团队之间不间断的沟通协作。

newsHighlights.title: Iraqi PM confirms complete withdrawal of US-led coalition forces
newsHighlights.summary: The Iraqi prime minister confirmed the complete withdrawal of US-led coalition forces after months of diplomatic negotiation.
newsHighlights.translation: 经过数月外交协商，伊拉克总理确认美国主导的联军部队已完全撤离。

newsHighlights.title: Pinglu Canal sees tourism boom during China's National Day holiday
newsHighlights.summary: The Pinglu Canal is seeing a tourism boom during the National Day holiday, reigniting interest in the region's heritage and modern charm.
newsHighlights.translation: 国庆假期期间平陆运河旅游火爆，重新点燃了人们对当地历史底蕴与现代魅力的兴趣。

quote.quote: The art of communication is the language of leadership.
quote.author: James Humes
quote.translation: 沟通的艺术，就是领导力的语言。
quote.explanation: 真正有影响力的人，靠的不是权力压制，而是清晰、真诚、有策略的表达。无论在职场谈判还是日常协作中，会沟通的人才能赢得信任、推动共识。

vocabulary.example: Coercion is not the right approach to settling differences between partners.
vocabulary.translation: 胁迫不是解决伙伴之间分歧的正确方式。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自新闻标题 'Coercion not the right approach to settling differences'，批评以施压代替对话的沟通方式。

vocabulary.definition: 方法，途径；接近，着手处理
vocabulary.example: Dialogue is a better approach than pressure when opinions differ.
vocabulary.translation: 当意见不一致时，对话是比施压更好的方法。
vocabulary.newsContext: 新闻标题中的核心词：'Coercion not the right approach to settling differences'。

vocabulary.definition: 赌注；利害关系（常用复数 stakes）
vocabulary.example: In every negotiation, both sides should know what is at stake.
vocabulary.translation: 在任何谈判中，双方都应清楚其中的利害关系。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自新闻摘要：'raise the stakes, set a deadline and hope that Beijing is the one to blink first'。

vocabulary.example: Setting an unrealistic deadline can damage trust in a team.
vocabulary.translation: 设定不切实际的截止日期会损害团队中的信任。
vocabulary.newsContext: 新闻摘要提到欧盟谈判策略之一是 'set a deadline'，即设定最后期限施压。

vocabulary.definition: 眨眼；（在对峙中）退缩、让步
vocabulary.example: In a tough talk, the one who blinks first usually loses ground.
vocabulary.translation: 在艰难的对话中，先退缩的一方往往会失去主动。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自新闻摘要 'hope that Beijing is the one to blink first'，blink 在此指在博弈中先让步。

vocabulary.definition: 里程碑；重大事件，转折点
vocabulary.example: Finishing the project on time was a real milestone for the whole team.
vocabulary.translation: 按时完成这个项目对整个团队来说是一个真正的里程碑。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自新闻 'Targeting a continental shift'：'marked a milestone more than five decades in the making'。

vocabulary.example: The withdrawal of the proposal surprised everyone at the meeting.
vocabulary.translation: 该提案的撤回让与会的所有人都感到意外。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自 CGTN 新闻：'Iraqi PM confirms complete withdrawal of US-led coalition forces'。

vocabulary.example: A sincere apology can reignite cooperation after a conflict.
vocabulary.translation: 真诚的道歉能在冲突之后重新点燃合作。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自新闻 'Heritage, modern chic reignite capital's charm' 及平陆运河旅游报道。

vocabulary.example: A steady tone of voice helps calm a heated discussion.
vocabulary.translation: 平稳的语调有助于平息激烈的讨论。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自新闻标题 'What keeps China's high-speed trains so steady?'，形容高铁运行平稳。

vocabulary.example: Please confirm the meeting time by email before Friday.
vocabulary.translation: 请在周五之前通过邮件确认会议时间。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自新闻 'Iraqi PM confirms complete withdrawal of US-led coalition forces'，confirm 用于正式表态与信息确认。

pattern.pattern: … is not the right approach to (doing) sth.
pattern.example: Coercion is not the right approach to settling differences.
pattern.translation: 胁迫不是解决分歧的正确方式。
pattern.usage: 用来委婉而坚定地否定某种做法，并暗示存在更好的替代方案。approach 后接 to + 名词/动名词（注意 to 是介词）。职场中可用于会议、邮件、谈判：'Rushing the decision is not the right approach to building consensus.'（仓促决策不是达成共识的正确方法。）

grammar.title: 现在进行时表示正在变化的趋势（Present Continuous for developing trends）
grammar.explanation: 新闻英语常用「be + increasingly/growing 等副词 + 形容词」或现在进行时来描述正在发生、逐渐加剧的趋势，比一般现在时更有动态感。常见结构：主语 + is/are becoming / acquiring / growing + increasingly + 形容词。职场沟通中可用于汇报变化、预警风险。
examples: The European Union's trade policy toward China is acquiring an increasingly familiar look.
The Pinglu Canal is seeing a tourism boom during the National Day holiday.

pronunciation.tips: 重音在第二个音节 -er- 上：/koʊ-ˈɜːr-ʒn/。注意 -sion 在元音后常读 /ʒn/（如 decision /dɪˈsɪʒn/、television），不要读成 /ʃən/。第一个音节是双元音 /oʊ/，口型由半合到合。可拆解练习：co - ER - zhun，最后的 /ʒn/ 是浊音，舌尖不接触上颚。
examples: Coercion is not the right approach to settling differences.
They rejected coercion in favor of open dialogue.

reading.title: Talking, Not Pressuring: What Trade Disputes Teach Us About Workplace Communication
reading.content:
A recent ChinaDaily commentary points out that the European Union's trade policy toward China is acquiring an increasingly familiar look: raise the stakes, set a deadline and hope the other side blinks first. The article argues that coercion is not the right approach to settling differences.

The same lesson applies in the office. When two departments disagree over a project, the loudest voice rarely wins lasting support. Instead, experienced leaders explain their concerns clearly, confirm what is at stake, and invite the other side to respond. They replace pressure with dialogue, and deadlines with shared plans.

Good communication also means admitting limits. Saying "I don't have all the answers yet" builds more trust than pretending to know everything. And when a conflict does end, a sincere follow-up can reignite cooperation.

Whether between nations or colleagues, respect and patience remain the steadiest foundation for any relationship.
reading.translation:
最近一篇《中国日报》评论指出，欧盟对华贸易政策呈现出越来越熟悉的套路：抬高筹码、设定最后期限，然后赌对方先退缩。文章认为，胁迫不是解决分歧的正确方式。

同样的道理也适用于办公室。当两个部门在某个项目上意见不合时，嗓门最大的人 rarely 能赢得长久的支持。相反，有经验的领导者会清楚地说明自己的顾虑，确认双方的利害关系，并邀请对方回应。他们用对话代替施压，用共同计划代替最后期限。

良好的沟通也意味着承认局限。说一句“我还没有全部答案”，比假装无所不知更能建立信任。而当冲突真正结束时，一次真诚的后续跟进能够重新点燃合作。

无论在国家之间还是同事之间，尊重与耐心始终是一切关系最稳固的基石。
reading.sourceNote: 本文基于 ChinaDaily 评论文章《Coercion not the right approach to settling differences》及 CGTN 关于伊拉克撤军的报道改写，用于英语学习目的。
